key_highlights: ASX slides as Brent crude nears US$100 amid Iran conflict, fuelling RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks fall
Iron ore under severe pressure – 'drowning, not waving' – as China demand softens and Beijing signals impatience with Trump tariffs
RBA perceived to be 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic, creating a stagflationary policy dilemma
Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; high-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment holds
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic liquidity concerns
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; WA gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) see strong drill-out activity
Power giant seeks to repurpose coal plants for AI data centres; NSW faces potential power shortfall
Qantas fires workers with $35m payout; Australia Post delivery fees hit small businesses

sectors.trend: Iron ore in freefall as China demand weakens and geopolitical risk disrupts trade flows. Copper (Flagship) and gold (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) see relative strength. Austal bid at US$1.9b signals M&A activity in industrials.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore weakness. Gold juniors in WA offer counter-cyclical upside. Copper exposure (STO.AX, FMG.AX) benefits from red-metal rally.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate-hike expectations, compressing net interest margin outlook. Bathla collapse signals private credit stress. Qantas $35m payout pressures QAN.AX. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight adds regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rate-hike-driven credit risk. Private credit exposure (via fund managers) warrants caution. QAN.AX faces structural cost headwinds.

sectors.trend: Brent near US$100 on Iran conflict. US energy stocks rise premarket. Power giant seeks AI data centre use for coal plants. NSW power adequacy questioned. Data centres threaten energy transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (WES.AX, AGL.AX) creates long-term structural demand but regulatory risk. Energy transition stocks face headwinds.

sectors.trend: Systemic underfunding: year-long colonoscopy waits, cancer patients blindsided by out-of-pocket costs, new babies' hospital plans criticised. Structural demand remains but policy risk elevated.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, CWY.AX face policy pressure but long-term demand intact. Out-of-pocket cost issues may accelerate private health insurance (IAG.AX, MHC.AX) uptake.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Home buyer sentiment collapses. High-end property falls steepest. Australia Post fees hurt small businesses. NZ house crash echoes.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, IAG.AX consumer exposure under pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX) face rental yield compression. Property developers (DHG.AX, SRG.AX) see high-end weakness.

sectors.trend: AI data centre demand surging at coal sites. Anthropic AI safety concerns. ATO vs Big Tech tax battle. GE Vernova outperforming Dow on energy transition.
sectors.implications: Data centre build-out benefits infrastructure (WES.AX, AGL.AX). Tech tax risk (ATO) pressures foreign-listed exposure. AI capex cycle supports power demand.

key_themes: Stagflation risk: oil near $100 + RBA forced into recessionary policy + business conditions at pandemic lows
Iron ore structural weakness: China demand collapse, Beijing-US trade friction
Housing bifurcation: high-end crash vs affordable resilience; buyer sentiment at milestone low
Private credit contagion: Bathla collapse signals broader liquidity stress
Energy transition vs AI data centre demand: coal repurposing, NSW power adequacy
WA gold junior rally: multiple drill-outs and offtake deals signal sector confidence
Geopolitical oil premium: Iran conflict, missile strikes, China crude buying rebound

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive sectors; favour energy and gold; reduce duration in bonds

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate to gold and copper
Review exposure to private credit funds; favour listed, liquid instruments

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration and buyer sentiment collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property developers and REITs; monitor RBA mortgage policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power adequacy and energy transition disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO data; favour generators with data centre contracts

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Business conditions at pandemic lows – recession risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX); reduce cyclical exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil near US$100
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict sustains premium; US energy stocks rising; Australian producers benefit from AUD-linked pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Position in copper via Flagship and diversified miners
opportunities.rationale: Copper 'red metal soars' on supply constraints and data centre/energy transition demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore-heavy large caps; rotate to gold/copper
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' on China demand weakness; BHP/RIO/FMG face margin compression
RBA rate-hike bets compress valuations; Bathla signals credit stress; housing sentiment collapsing
Business conditions at pandemic lows; recession risk elevates defensive positioning

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil near $100 drives rate-hike fears, iron ore weakens materials, business conditions at pandemic lows. Expect ^AXJO to test support. Banks and property under sell pressure. Gold and energy provide relative strength. Bathla contagion may trigger private credit repricing.
market_outlook.long_term: Stagflationary backdrop complicates RBA policy. Iron ore structural shift away from China is a multi-year headwind for BHP/RIO. Gold, copper, and energy remain structurally supported. Housing bifurcation persists. AI data centre demand creates new power infrastructure cycle. Recession risk in 2026-27 remains elevated.

Brent crude trajectory – sustained $100+ or de-escalation
China iron ore import data and Beijing-US trade posture
Bathla fallout and broader private credit stress indicators
US inflation data (awaited) and global rate expectations
WA gold junior drill results and offtake agreements

China PMI and crude import data
Bathla and private credit fund NAVs
